review_candidates.title: Executive Director – Steel Manufacturing
review_candidates.description: Job Title: Executive Director / CEO – Steel Manufacturing Industry: Steel Manufacturing Department: Executive Management Job Summary An experienced Executive Director responsible for overseeing the overall operations, strategic direction, and business performance of a steel manufacturing facility. Ensures efficient production, high product quality, cost control, operational excellence, and compliance with health, safety, and environmental regulations. Leads cross-functional teams to achieve production targets, maximize profitability, improve productivity, and support sustainable business growth. Key Responsibilities 1. Strategic Leadership and Management Develop and implement business strategies, operational plans, and long-term growth objectives. Lead the factory’s overall performance, ensuring alignment with company goals and financial targets. Manage budgets, operating expenses, capital investments, and resource allocation. Report operational and financial performance to the Board of Directors or company owners. 2. Steel Manufacturing and Production Oversee all manufacturing operations, production planning, and scheduling. Ensure production targets are achieved while maintaining product quality and minimizing waste. Monitor manufacturing processes, equipment utilization, production efficiency, and capacity. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to increase productivity and reduce manufacturing costs. Coordinate production activities according to customer specifications and delivery commitments. 3. Factory Operations and Maintenance Supervise plant operations, equipment reliability, preventive maintenance, and major maintenance activities. Ensure the availability of raw materials, spare parts, machinery, and production resources. Improve equipment performance and minimize unplanned downtime. Coordinate with engineering and maintenance teams to ensure safe and efficient plant operation. 4. Quality Control and Assurance Ensure compliance with applicable steel product standards, technical specifications, and customer requirements. Oversee quality assurance, inspection, testing, and corrective action processes. Reduce production defects, material losses, and customer complaints. Promote a culture of quality and continuous improvement throughout the factory. 5. Health, Safety, and Environmental Compliance Ensure compliance with occupational health and safety requirements and environmental regulations. Implement workplace safety procedures, risk assessments, and emergency response plans. Promote safe working practices across production, maintenance, warehousing, and logistics. Monitor environmental performance, waste management, and energy consumption. 6. Supply Chain and Commercial Management Oversee procurement, raw material planning, inventory control, warehousing, and logistics. Manage relationships with suppliers, contractors, customers, and other business partners. Support sales and commercial teams in production planning, order fulfillment, and customer satisfaction. Monitor material costs, inventory levels, and supply chain efficiency. 7. Human Resources and Team Development Lead and develop senior managers, department heads, engineers, supervisors, and factory employees. Establish clear performance indicators and accountability across departments. Support workforce planning, employee training, succession planning, and leadership development. Build a culture of teamwork, discipline, operational excellence, and continuous improvement. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Production output and capacity utilization. Manufacturing cost per ton. Product quality and rejection rates. Equipment downtime and overall equipment effectiveness (OEE). On-time delivery and customer satisfaction. Occupational safety performance. Energy consumption and material yield. Operating profit and budget performance. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related field. Extensive experience in steel manufacturing, factory management, and industrial operations. Proven leadership experience in managing large-scale manufacturing facilities. Strong knowledge of production planning, quality management, maintenance, cost control, and industrial safety. Excellent strategic planning, financial management, problem-solving, and leadership skills. Core Competencies: Executive Leadership | Steel Manufacturing | Factory Management | Production Optimization | Operational Excellence | Cost Reduction | Quality Assurance | Health and Safety | Supply Chain Management | Business Development

In this pivotal role, you will be instrumental in shaping our operations, driving strategic initiatives, and delivering exceptional results within your functional area. The ideal candidate will combine big-picture strategic thinking with hands-on, tactical execution. Key Responsibilities: Provide essential administrative, logistical, and operational support to the team. Manage daily scheduling, coordinate meetings, and facilitate cross-team communications. Manage accounts payable/receivable, billing cycles, and precise invoicing. Identify and implement strategic opportunities for cost reduction and financial efficiency. Conduct thorough financial audits and implement rigorous risk management controls. Required Skills & Qualifications: High-level proficiency in industry-standard accounting software and ERP systems. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables, financial modeling). Highly organized methodology with a strong ability to prioritize effectively. Proven comfort and productivity operating in a fully remote, distributed environment. High-level proficiency with QuickBooks, NetSuite, and advanced financial modeling software. What You’ll Bring: Strong analytical abilities coupled with a commitment to data-driven decision making. The proven ability to thrive and drive results in an ambiguous, fast-paced setting. An unwavering commitment to operational quality, accuracy, and overall excellence. Benefits: Fully remote, flexible work hours Performance-based bonus structure Annual learning & development stipend Health and wellness benefits (varies by location) Opportunity to work on high-impact projects Equal Opportunity Employer: This is an equal opportunity role. Applications are welcomed from all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, ethnicity, nationality, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, disability, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. All hiring decisions are based solely on qualifications, skills, and demonstrated ability. Apply Now!

review_candidates.title: Consultant (Energy - Renewables)
review_candidates.description: Nexus Analytica is seeking a Renewable Energy Consultant to support the delivery of consulting assignments related to solar PV, wind, battery energy storage systems (BESS), hybrid renewable projects, grid integration, and project agreements. This role combines technical, commercial, financial, and project coordination responsibilities. The selected candidate will work closely with multidisciplinary teams and clients to provide high-quality advisory support across project development, techno-economic analysis, project management, and renewable energy transactions. Key Responsibilities Support the delivery of consulting projects in renewable energy, including solar PV, wind, BESS, and hybrid systems. Conduct techno-economic assessments, scenario analysis, and financial evaluation for renewable energy projects. Support the review and development of PPAs, project agreements, tariff structures, and commercial frameworks. Assist in grid connection, interconnection, and renewable energy integration assessments. Review policy, regulatory, and market frameworks related to renewable energy investments and project implementation. Prepare reports, presentations, technical notes, and client deliverables. Coordinate with clients, developers, utilities, public authorities, and project stakeholders. Support project planning, workplans, timelines, and internal coordination across assignments. Contribute to proposal writing, technical offers, and business development activities. Participate in workshops, meetings, and capacity-building activities with clients and partners. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Sustainable Energy, Energy Economics, or a related field. 3 to 7 years of relevant experience in renewable energy consulting, project advisory, energy systems analysis, or related fields. Good understanding of solar PV, wind, BESS, grid integration, renewable energy planning, or project development. Familiarity with technical and commercial aspects of renewable energy projects. Strong analytical, report-writing, and presentation skills. Strong written and spoken English. Arabic is an advantage. Preferred Qualifications Master’s degree in a relevant field. Experience with techno-economic modelling and financial analysis. Exposure to PPAs, tariff design, project agreements, or regulatory review. Familiarity with tools such as Excel, Python, PLEXOS, PowerFactory, PSS/E, MATLAB, or similar. Experience working on projects in Egypt, MENA, or Africa is an advantage. Skills Renewable energy project analysis Techno-economic assessment Financial modelling Grid and interconnection understanding Project coordination Report writing and presentation Stakeholder management Commercial and regulatory awareness What We Offer Opportunity to work on high-impact renewable energy and energy transition projects Exposure to multidisciplinary consulting assignments across technical, financial, and regulatory topics A collaborative and intellectually stimulating work environment Professional growth in a fast-evolving energy consulting firm

review_candidates.description: 🚀 Public Events recrute : Chef de Projet Senior – Exhibitions (H/F) 📍 Casablanca | 📝 CDI Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités, Public Events recherche un(e) Chef(fe) de Projet Senior – Exhibitions pour piloter des projets d'expositions, de salons professionnels et d'aménagements événementiels de grande envergure. Véritable chef d'orchestre, vous serez garant(e) de la réussite des projets, de la phase de conception jusqu'à la livraison, en assurant la coordination des équipes internes, des prestataires et des clients. Vos principales missions Piloter l'ensemble du cycle de vie des projets d'exhibitions et d'aménagements de stands. Être l'interlocuteur privilégié des clients et assurer le suivi de leurs besoins. Élaborer les plannings, les budgets et garantir le respect des délais, des coûts et des exigences qualité. Coordonner les équipes créatives, techniques, de production et les partenaires externes. Superviser les phases de fabrication, de montage, de démontage et de livraison sur site. Identifier les risques liés aux projets et mettre en œuvre les actions correctives nécessaires. Assurer le suivi financier des projets, le contrôle des marges et le reporting auprès de la Direction. Participer aux appels d'offres, aux recommandations stratégiques et au développement commercial. Profil recherché Bac+5 en Gestion de Projet, Événementiel, Marketing, Architecture, Génie Civil ou équivalent. Expérience de 7 à 10 ans minimum en gestion de projets d'exhibitions, de salons professionnels, de stands ou d'événements. Excellente connaissance de la chaîne de production événementielle et des métiers de l'exhibition. Expérience confirmée dans la gestion de budgets importants et de projets complexes. Leadership, sens de l'organisation et excellente capacité à gérer plusieurs projets simultanément. Excellentes compétences en communication, négociation et gestion de la relation client. Maîtrise de Microsoft Office ; la connaissance d'outils de gestion de projet et d'ERP constitue un atout. La maîtrise du français est indispensable ; l'anglais est fortement apprécié. Pourquoi rejoindre Public Events ? Intégrer l'un des acteurs majeurs de l'événementiel au Maroc. Participer à la réalisation de projets d'envergure nationale et internationale. Évoluer dans un environnement dynamique, créatif et orienté performance. Bénéficier de réelles opportunités d'évolution au sein d'un groupe en pleine croissance. 📩 Vous souhaitez relever ce défi ? Adressez votre CV à recrutment@parthenon.ma en indiquant en objet : Chef de Projet Senior – Exhibitions – Casablanca .
